purpose: Small synthetic core inputs for diagnosing source correspondence and review readability. Current output is evidence, never the expected oracle.
coordinates: Input page numbers below are 1-based physical pages. Characters use synthetic six-point advance and size 10; line spacing defaults to 24 points.
limits: These inputs bypass PDF extraction and the browser UI.
Passing the minimum core checks does not establish that the requested UI behavior is fixed.
Do not remove all whitespace: a token-boundary change is an intentional negative control.
No exact total difference count is required; standalone all-whitespace correspondence records are forbidden even when hidden.
The fixture company is fictional and is not copied from a customer policy.

expected: Whitespace-only lines must not create exported correspondence/difference records, regardless of defaultVisible.
Whitespace-only lines must not establish cross-page alignment.
Original input characters can remain available for source inspection.

left.text: Stable readable clause remains in the same document.

right.text: Stable readable clause remains in the same document.

expected: Adding or removing unrelated empty space must not create an exported moved-text record, even if hidden.
The readable clause retains its text; the empty lines do not gain meaning from a competing anchor.
Empty space does not establish alignment, even when its order conflicts with real anchors.
The visible heading has not changed.
Retaining a source-backed whitespace record is allowed; the UI must classify it as layout/spacing, rather than a substantive text change.
This core-only runner cannot verify default UI grouping or wording.
The unchanged heading must not gain the unrelated page-13 blank as its corresponding source.
An empty line on a distant page is not evidence of text reflow.
Hiding a card alone is insufficient if that incorrect source linkage remains in exported evidence.
Both documents contain the company name twice; all 2+2 source occurrences must remain independently verifiable in the output.
If individual occurrences cannot be paired uniquely, preserve that uncertainty and the sources on both sides.
Technical Added/Removed records are an allowed conservative representation when uncertainty is retained. Their kind alone does not establish an algorithmic mispairing or a repair failure.
The UI must avoid translating that uncertainty into a definite assertion that the company disappeared or was newly added.
Do not force pairing by order merely to eliminate an uncertainty notice.

Missing source evidence is FAIL. Retained sources with an unverified pairing are NOT_EVALUATED, never PASS. Independent authored source anchors can verify local pairs without requiring an unresolved record.
The real year change remains visible after any whitespace/noise fix.
Exported delete/insert operations retain references to the actual changed last digits.
Removing the separator changes token boundaries and must remain a meaningful text difference.
It must not disappear under a rule that removes all whitespace before comparison.
It must not be labeled whitespace_only.
